_readme: Frozen benchmark task set (WP0). Commit this file BEFORE the first measured run; the git timestamp is the proof the tasks were not tuned to the results. generate_ideas feeds `genbench genpipe --ideas bench/tasks.json` (5 ideas, one full idea→plan→generate→heal→verify pipeline each). understand_targets are public repos pinned to a commit for the Understand benchmark (parse / resolution / cfg suites). Do not edit between runs of the same study.
generate_ideas: A small library lending service: members borrow and return books, librarians add books and see overdue loans
An inventory service for a hardware store: products with stock counts, suppliers, and purchase orders that restock products
A gym membership service: members, plans and checkins; staff can freeze or cancel memberships
A support ticket tracker: customers open tickets, agents reply to tickets and close them, tags for triage
An event registration service: events with capacity, attendees register and cancel, a waitlist promotes automatically

understand_targets.name: cobolcraft
understand_targets.note: same pinned corpus as the frozen baseline (generator/internal/bench/baselines/)
